regions.full_page: May 8 or 9 Barbara Haag Enrolled one year - continual convulsions - only 5 months old. Parents promise perpetual Enrollment if child improves. To-night they bring her stiff and rigid, crying and in spasms, asking to have a Mass said in Honor of St. Anthony. Fr. S. asked, "Did you see no improvement?" "Yes, Some .. " ....... "Then a single Mass," said Fr. S. "will not help. Keep your promise and God will do the rest." They pay $3. on perpetual enrolment. At once she sleeps & smiles. !!! $600.00 on doctors

regions.full_page: Monday - Dorothy Neary 24 - 5712 Winslow Ave. £ Enrolled as against stomach trouble -"Ulcers" Could not eat - milk & cream only. Enrol- led July 27 then intending to have ex-ray Examination next day ..... Went on excursion to Buffalo in perfect health. Enrolles To-night perpetually - herself and Poor Souls. Deo Gratias! P.S. She promised perpetual enrollment ....
